## About
Hassle Free Contracting is a full-service roofing contractor on Colorado Blvd in Denver. We do asphalt, tile and metal roofing for residential, commercial and multi-family applications, from roof repair to replacement.
We started out in the mountains, dealing with harsh elements, UV exposure and temperature swings. Bringing that experience to Denver has helped us build roofs that stand the test of time.
When you call, you're paired with one project manager who stays with you from estimation to installation. We keep your property clean, limit interruption to your life or business, and keep you in the loop every step of the way. Customers have rated us 5 on Google across 24 reviews.

## Services
- Roof Inspections: Give us a call and we'll come take an honest look at your roof. Inspections are free.
- Roof Replacements: Full replacements for homes and properties, from the first estimate to the final walk through.
- Roof Repairs: Repairs to keep your roof doing its job. One customer said Matt helped them on a very tight turnaround.
- Storm Damage Work: Storm restoration for roofs hit by hail and rough Colorado weather.
- Asphalt Shingle: Asphalt shingle roofing for residential, commercial and multi-family buildings.
- Metal Roofing: Metal roofs, plus metalwork like coping caps and chimney caps when your home needs them.
- Tile roofing: Tile roofing installed by skilled tradesmen.
- Commercial: Roofing for commercial and multi-family properties, with the same single point of contact.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies, and one reviewer who replaced her roof after a hail storm said we worked directly with her insurance company.

Q: Where do you work?
A: We're based in Denver and serve the Denver Metro and the entire Front Range.

Q: Do you charge for a roof inspection?
A: No. Call (720) 810-1991 to set up a free roof inspection.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Saturday, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
